hints.title: Right-to-Left Carry Arithmetic
hints.text: Simulate elementary school addition by traversing the digits array from least significant to most significant while adding k.

hints.title: Direct Carry Absorption
hints.text: Treat k itself as the running carry. Add the last digit of num to k, append k % 10 to the result, and set k = k // 10.

hints.title: Reverse Digits Assembly
hints.text: Initialize index i = len(num) - 1 and result array. While i >= 0 or k > 0: if i >= 0, k += num[i]; append k % 10 to result; k //= 10; decrement i. Return reversed result array.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting num to a native integer directly fails in languages without arbitrary-precision integer support when num length exceeds 64 bits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating digit addition processes each digit in O(1) time and builds the result in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid big-integer overflow by treating k as the carry and doing standard digit-wise addition.
complexity.notes: Reverse the accumulated digits at the end to restore normal order.
